about: Observer mode (companion/life/narrator_love.py): the Watching feed's lines for a love life or a friendship, told on the day from the rows that already exist. {first} is the watched companion's first name, {other} their own partner's; the user is "you". One line per moment, picked by seeded dice, so a day reads the same every time. Never odds: the feeling comes through in words.
